A movie screening. A room full of UPSC aspirants. And a conversation that went far beyond the exam.

From self-belief and finding the right guidance to understanding what it takes to sustain yourself through a long preparation journey, this session gave aspirants a different perspective on UPSC preparation.

Here’s what the students had to say about their experience with Sonali Ma’am and the lessons they took away.

Because sometimes, preparation isn't just about what you study. It's also about how you handle the journey.

Want to work on the other side of your UPSC preparation too?
